title: Refund Picker
description: Prevents refund surprises and disputes by letting staff or customers pick units per item (or a set amount that can't exceed what the items allow), naming every restocking and return-shipping deduction, keeping non-refundable items visible with the reason, showing each refund method's own net amount and real arrival dates, and reading the whole refund back in one sentence before it's issued.
stops: Refund smaller than the customer expected
